first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for Historic England NHLE List Entry 1495589 (Exeter Central Station, Exeter). The official NHLE record identifies a Grade II railway station building and supplies NGR SX9186692958; that NGR was used only to address a distinct layer-3 spatial-intersects query. The official polygon query URL was inaccessible before any feature payload or polygon coordinates could be read, so no geometry was inferred or fabricated and no individual building record was accepted.
